data.name: Mountain Hike Tour (meditation optional) 10:30 AM
data.headline: 18 ages or older • 2 hours
data.description: This easy hiking tour shows a different side of San Diego. The views are unforgettable. The freshness of nature instantly brings serenity into your experience as you hike and breathe in sage. Your tour guide will provide multiple fun picture breaks so you can leave San Diego with memorable moments.
data.highlights:
During this guided tour, customers will receive a transformative experience immersed in nature. The tour includes a hike up a beautiful mountain surrounded by real sage plants to cleanse inner chaos.

Your tour guide will allow you moments to reflect and take in the beauty of nature while capturing memorable moments.

Participants will embark on a quiet nature walk to release inner pain to Mother Nature, leaving them feeling rejuvenated and refreshed.
data.itinerary:
1. Meet at the visitor's center entrance. Your guide will tell you some fun facts about the history of the park.
2. Walk Mission Trails to the mountain
3. Hike Cowles Mountain with an experienced guide
4. Take memorable photos with beautiful views
5. Take a wonderful nature walk to release anxiety, stress, and stuck energy.
6. End at the visitor's center

meeting_point.address: 1 Father Junipero Serra Trail, San Diego, CA 92119

data.cancellation_notes: No refunds. A full refund will be issued if the tour guide cancels due to weather or unforeseen circumstances.
data.accessibility: Not wheelchair accessible. Service animals allowed
